nom: Rael Miracle Patch 3-Step Pore Melting Pack

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation from the melting or soothing steps, though some warn the physical extraction step could be harsh for sensitive skin.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, blackhead-prone noses report the kit softens and sometimes reduces visible blackheads, though results vary and some see them return.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes her nose is normally drier and larger-pored, and found the treatment left the area smooth without dryness.
segments.mature: No reviewer specifically identifies as having mature skin in relation to this product.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers use this specifically for blackheads on the nose; many report visible reduction or removal after use, but several say it did nothing for their blackheads and a few note blackheads looked more noticeable afterward.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with cystic acne reports the kit softened sebum and emptied clogged pores effectively; another struggling with blackheads and acne says it simply did not work for her.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers highlight no redness or irritation after use, and one specifically notes the soothing step calmed redness; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the treatment as gentler than traditional pore strips, with several noting no irritation, sting, or dryness, though a couple mention burning or stinging on application.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note the sheets are non-drying and leave skin feeling soft or hydrated, contrasting with harsher pore strips that dried out skin.

aspects.libelle: Gentler than traditional rip-off pore strips

extraits.texte: This kit was very easy to use and seems more effective than the other popular pore strips (which usually don't work for me). Step 1 had a tingly minty feeling, and a subtle minty scent. It really loosened up the gunk on my pores, and I was able to get a satisfying squeeze after. The swab wasn't very effective (the hole wasn't quite the right angle to squeeze stuff out) , but I appreciate that it's black so I can easily see impurities and with how small it is, I can stash it in my purse. I have super sensitive skin and step 1 and step 3 didn't irritate it at all! The soother mask really calmed down the redness, and I even use the leftover liquid as a serum. I was able to wear my glasses while using the masks. Definitely recommend this 3-step kit for anyone looking for a deep pore cleanse of the nose area!

I have cystic acne and my pores get clogged easily and its hard to extract black heads. The first sheet made my skin and the sebum really soft and makiable, the swabs have an extractor at one end, and the swab part is a slightly abrasive material that clings onto the gunk and pulls it out. The soothing sheet is a nice toner to calm thr skin after. My pores are empty! I used it on my nose and chin, and I'll be using it every week from now on ❤️

Have tried these a few time. They sting upon application, which I assume is the peppermint. Not a refreshing tingle, more of a burning sting. Doesn't penetrate my pores at all, pore strips feel more effective and honestly, more gentl.

When I received the opportunity to try Rael's 3-Step Pore Melting Kit I was so excited to try this out! My nose is always oily & quickly has blackheads which will forever annoy me. When I opened step one I immediately noticed that it was seemingly close to one of the wet paper masks. I followed the instructions in step one and the sheet kept falling off my nose. When I went in with the sebum tips I had to push down to get the debris up truly and used 2 in 1 go. The soothing step 3 felt just like a slimy mess and also kept falling off my nose. I did see a difference, however, it was still slight. It was a neat experience to have in the end. I wouldn't suggest it to others though.

I got this product for blackheads. It works really good to remove whiteheads and leaves your nose looking and feeling smooth. But it doesn't really work for blackheads and tbh blackheads become even more noticeable afterwards.

I actually really liked this product! After I went through all of the steps, the area was extremely smooth when my skin around my nose is a little rough between it being a little drier and larger pores. I can see this product being a great first step before makeup before taking photos because it really smoothed out the area of my nose where sometimes I have trouble with foundation being patchy because of the texture that is normally there. The instructions were easy to follow and the masks were fully soaked in product. The masks didn't slide around too much so I was able to still move around a bit without worrying about it sliding off and could multitask while doing the mask. It had a nice light fragrance that wasn't overpowering so if someone is sensitive to scents, I don't think this will be a concern. I think it is pretty reasonable priced for a 3 pack so I really am impressed overall.
I was excited to try this because I've been struggling with blackheads and acne, it just didn't really work for me tho.
